# 1. Load results

```{python}
#| label: load
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# LaTeX (Computer Modern), consistent with other reports
plt.rcParams.update({
    "text.usetex":     True,
    "font.family":     "serif",
    "font.size":       9,
    "axes.titlesize":  10,
    "axes.labelsize":  10,
    "legend.fontsize": 8,
    "text.latex.preamble": r"\usepackage{amsmath}\usepackage{amssymb}",
})

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("./lib")))
import sweep_runner as sr

OUT          = Path("./sweep/runs/stage0b_phi_convention")
results_csv  = OUT / "results.csv"
decision_txt = OUT / "decision.txt"
traces_dir   = OUT / "traces"

assert results_csv.exists(), f"Run `python sweep/bin/run_stage0b.py` first — {results_csv} not found."
df = pd.read_csv(results_csv).sort_values("phi_sim_deg").reset_index(drop=True)

cols = ["phi_sim_deg", "Rdet_chi2_red", "Rdet_RMSE",
        "Rdet_pearson_r", "R_chi2_red", "runtime_s"]
df[cols].round(4)
```

# 2. R_det(λ) per φ_sim, with experimental ⟨R⟩

```{python}
#| label: figure

CENTRE = dict(
    period_um        = 12.9,
    A_um             = 1.5,
    t_oxide_um       = 0.30,
    oxide_dispersion = "HS_caliente",
    theta_deg        = 30.0,
    harmonics        = 39,        # locked by Stage 0a
    slices           = 50,
    beta_deg         = 2.0,
    wavelengths_um   = np.arange(3.0, 25.0, 0.25),
)
SAMPLE = "12-3"
THETA_EXP, PHI_EXP = 30, 0

# Experimental ⟨R⟩ ± σ (interpolated onto the simulation λ grid for the overlay)
from scipy.interpolate import interp1d
EXP_DIR = Path("../data/experimental")
exp_files = sorted(EXP_DIR.glob(f"{SAMPLE}_{THETA_EXP}_{PHI_EXP}_*.CSV"))
exp_repeats = []
for f in exp_files:
    raw = pd.read_csv(f, header=None, names=["wn", "R_pct"])
    raw = raw[raw["R_pct"] > 0].copy()
    raw["lambda_um"] = 1e4 / raw["wn"]
    raw["R"] = raw["R_pct"] / 100.0
    raw = raw.sort_values("lambda_um").reset_index(drop=True)
    exp_repeats.append((raw["lambda_um"].values, raw["R"].values))

lam_sim = CENTRE["wavelengths_um"]
R_stack = np.array([
    interp1d(l, r, bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan, assume_sorted=True)(lam_sim)
    for l, r in exp_repeats
])
R_exp_mean = np.nanmean(R_stack, axis=0)
R_exp_std  = np.nanstd(R_stack, axis=0, ddof=1)

# Plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.5), constrained_layout=True)

phi_grid = sorted(df["phi_sim_deg"].astype(float).tolist())
cmap = plt.cm.viridis
chi2_per_phi = {}

for i, phi in enumerate(phi_grid):
    cfg = sr.SimConfig(phi_sim_deg=phi, **CENTRE)
    stem = cfg.filename_stem()
    avg = pd.read_csv(traces_dir / stem / f"AVG_{stem}.csv")
    color = cmap(i / max(len(phi_grid) - 1, 1))
    chi2 = float(df[df["phi_sim_deg"] == phi]["Rdet_chi2_red"].iloc[0])
    chi2_per_phi[phi] = chi2
    ax[0].plot(avg["x"], avg["R_det"], lw=1.4, color=color,
               label=rf"$\varphi_{{\mathrm{{sim}}}}={phi:g}^{{\circ}}\;(\chi^2_{{\mathrm{{red}}}}={chi2:.0f})$")

# Experimental overlay
ax[0].fill_between(lam_sim, R_exp_mean - R_exp_std, R_exp_mean + R_exp_std,
                   color="C2", alpha=0.20)
ax[0].plot(lam_sim, R_exp_mean, color="C2", lw=2.0,
           label=r"$\langle R \rangle_{\mathrm{exp}}\!\pm\!\sigma$")

ax[0].set_xlabel(r"$\lambda \;[\mu\mathrm{m}]$")
ax[0].set_ylabel(r"$\langle R_{\mathrm{det}} \rangle_{\mathrm{sim}}\,(\beta=2^{\circ})$")
ax[0].set_title(r"$R_{\mathrm{det}}(\lambda)$ vs simulation azimuth $\varphi_{\mathrm{sim}}$")
ax[0].legend(loc="lower right", framealpha=0.85, fontsize=7)
ax[0].grid(True, alpha=0.4)

# χ² bar chart
phi_list = sorted(chi2_per_phi)
chi2_list = [chi2_per_phi[p] for p in phi_list]
chosen_phi = min(chi2_per_phi, key=chi2_per_phi.get)
colors = ["C2" if p == chosen_phi else "C0" for p in phi_list]
ax[1].bar([f"{p:g}°" for p in phi_list], chi2_list, color=colors)
ax[1].set_xlabel(r"$\varphi_{\mathrm{sim}}$")
ax[1].set_ylabel(r"$\chi^2_{\mathrm{red}}(R_{\mathrm{det}})$")
ax[1].set_title(rf"argmin = $\varphi_{{\mathrm{{sim}}}} = {chosen_phi:g}^{{\circ}}$")
ax[1].grid(True, alpha=0.4, axis="y")

plt.show()
```

# 4. What this locks in

The chosen `φ_sim` corresponds to experimental `φ_exp = 0°`. Every
subsequent stage (Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3) uses this fixed mapping
between the two coordinate conventions when scoring against
experimental data at any φ_exp.

Combined with Stage 0a (NA = 39 locked), the convergence /
convention pair is now nailed down. Tier-1 universal sweep
(`t_oxide × β × oxide_dispersion`) is unblocked.

> See [docs/SWEEP_PLAN.md](../../design/SWEEP_PLAN.md) "Stage 1" for the
> next step.
